As others have said, we're a free forum. Anything and everything is welcome here, with few exceptions like kiddy porn, spam, illegal activities, and such. No one is banned by admins or mods (generally speaking) for stating an opinion one way or the other, unless you violate the very basic rules, or more possibly in subs if you violate it's specific rules spelled out clearly in the sidebars. Subverses of all stripes can be found here. Some you'll enjoy, some you may find offensive, but we have a live and let live attitude and if you don't like the content, just move on by and ignore it. You can even block users or subs that you don't want to see ... but most of us just ignore that which we object to. It's called freedom of speech, and all can say what they want. You may not get a good response if it's unpopular, but you won't be banned because of it. And shadow bans as other sites have simply don't exist. We also have full transparency, so that if someone is banned by a sub mod, or a post is deleted, there's a full record of it with an explanation in the sidebar of that sub. So there's nothing hidden here. We are the opposite of many of the other competitors, a place all can find a home, if they wish.

Minimal moderation, with crap being removed chiefly being spam etc. On the upside, this means that freedom of speech is protected. On the downside, it also means that some people will invariably show their worst sides due to a lack of social repercussions. The thing to keep in mind is that the latter doesn't matter if you grow a thick skin, whereas admin abuse as in the case of the former is notably more significant to deal with.

Content wise - Voat chiefly consists of people who abandoned Reddit for some reason or another. Means you'll find some less-than-polite people here (cf. Slow-Cooker Pepper Steak

Ingredients

2 pounds beef sirloin, cut into 2 inch strips

garlic powder to taste

3 tablespoons vegetable oil

1 cube beef bouillon

1/4 cup hot water

1 tablespoon cornstarch

1/2 cup chopped onion

2 large green bell peppers, roughly chopped

1 (14.5 ounce) can stewed tomatoes, with liquid

3 tablespoons soy sauce

1 teaspoon white sugar

1 teaspoon salt

Directions

Sprinkle strips of sirloin with garlic powder to taste. In a large skillet over medium heat, heat the vegetable oil and brown the seasoned beef strips. Transfer to a slow cooker.

Mix bouillon cube with hot water until dissolved, then mix in cornstarch until dissolved. Pour into the slow cooker with meat. Stir in onion, green peppers, stewed tomatoes, soy sauce, sugar, and salt.

Cover, and cook on High for 3 to 4 hours, or on Low for 6 to 8 hours. Serve over rice or noodles.
